newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: HK's Tsang says pursuing more repo agreements.
newsitem.headline: HK's Tsang says pursuing more repo agreements.

text.p: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Thursday that the territory was looking to expand its range of repurchase agreements with other countries' central banks.

"Hong Kong is rather keen to enter into repurchase agreements with a number of central banks. That came home after the Mexican peso crisis early last year," Tsang told a news conference during a visit to New Zealand.
Since then, Hong Kong had entered six or seven repurchase arrangements with neighbouring countries, "and we can extend and talk to more".
Tsang this was an area he could pursue with the Reserve Bank of New Zealand during his current visit.
